name: Passive Euthanasia
overview: Scripture affirms the sanctity of human life as made in God's image, forbidding the taking of life as stated in Exodus 20:13 and Genesis 9:6. While Ecclesiastes acknowledges that there is a divinely appointed time to die and that no one has control over the spirit at death, this does not grant permission to hasten death through passive euthanasia. Instead, believers are called to endure suffering with patience and to respond to adversity with blessing rather than harm, reflecting a trust in God's sovereign timing and purposes.
